review.tagline: Coding agent with TUI, Desktop and Web clients over one local service
review.summary: DeepCode is a coding agent that works in your repository from a terminal UI, a native desktop app or a browser workbench, all connected to one shared local background service. Projects, sessions, models, skills, permissions, goals and automations are shared across clients. It also includes a Paper2Code pipeline that turns research papers into code. Models are user-configured, with provider templates including Opper and Amazon Bedrock.
review.audience: Developers wanting a self-run coding agent with terminal, desktop and web UIs
strengths: Three clients (TUI, Desktop, Web) share sessions and approvals through one local service
Sandboxed commands, with opt-in egress limits, command screening and OS keychain key storage
Goal loops, parallel agents, reusable skills, MCP support and automations are built in
Bring your own cloud or local model, with per-session context caps and /compact
weaknesses: No Docker or compose files detected; install is through a Python runtime
Frequent releases with behavior changes across TUI, Desktop and Web
RAM and hardware requirements are not stated in the README excerpt
needs: Needs Python 3.12+, LLM provider or local model server
Models: Amazon Bedrock, Opper, DeepSeek V4, GLM-5.2, custom model servers
